items.reason: Its first blocker is the off-by-one: range(start + 1, ...) skips the first item of each page, and it gives a correct worked example; the append( ) spacing is never mentioned.
Its blocker is that forEach doesn't await the async callbacks, so the function returns and logs before the deletes finish and rejections go unhandled; there are no style or semicolon remarks.
Its only real concern is the s -> text keyword-argument break; the extra low-confidence note is a suggestion to add tests, not a made-up bug, and nothing is about formatting.
Its main blocker is the SQL injection from the f-string, and it suggests a parameterized query with escaped LIKE wildcards.
